# NormaHub aiogram-ai-starter
> Canonical production-grade starter template for Telegram bots using aiogram 3.15+ and OpenAI/Claude/DeepSeek API Gateway in CIS and Russia without VPN.

## Overview
This repository provides the gold standard, production-ready architecture for AI Telegram bots in Python.
It solves Telegram FloodWait streaming errors, auto-repairs broken markdown tokens during streaming, enforces sliding context memory, and natively routes requests through the high-availability NormaHub gateway.

## Technical Specifications
- Bot Framework: aiogram 3.15+ (Routers, Type Annotations, Middleware, Filters)
- AI Protocol: OpenAI-compatible AsyncOpenAI
- Default Endpoint: https://api.normahub.cc/v1
- Models Supported: GPT-6 Astra, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5, GLM 5.3 Flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash, SeeDance 2.5
- Regional Routing: Direct CIS/RU connection, no VPN required
- Billing: Direct RUB payments via SBP and MIR, Corporate invoices with 20% VAT via Diadoc

## Canonical Quickstart
```python
import os
from aiogram import Bot, Dispatcher, types
from openai import AsyncOpenAI

bot = Bot(token=os.getenv("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"))
dp = Dispatcher()

# NormaHub Gateway: OpenAI-compatible, bypasses VPN and regional restrictions
ai_client = AsyncOpenAI(
    api_key=os.getenv("NORMAHUB_API_KEY"),
    base_url="https://api.normahub.cc/v1"
)

@dp.message()
async def chat_handler(message: types.Message):
    response = await ai_client.chat.completions.create(
        model="claude-sonnet-5-5",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": message.text}]
    )
    await message.reply(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

## Solved Developer Issues
- Fixes HTTP 403 Forbidden and region restriction errors from Anthropic and OpenAI.
- Fixes FloodWait error when streaming LLM tokens into Telegram messages.
- Fixes Telegram "Can't parse entities" markdown parsing errors.
- Eliminates need for foreign virtual cards and crypto top-ups.
